paragraphs: AngelTrax sells mobile video surveillance systems built for transportation safety. The company describes its customers as student transportation, mass transit, fleet, locomotive, and waste operations.

On a school bus, interior, exterior, stop-arm, and windshield views cover students, drivers, and transportation staff. Footage leaves the vehicle two ways, and a cellular link carries live view, active tracking, and instant notifications. Wi-Fi handles automated downloads once vehicles return to range. Video and data can be hosted by AngelTrax at its secure U.S. data center rather than handed to a third party. Its online software covers live view, downloads, vehicle location, health reporting, stop-arm workflows, and driver behavior. Driver behavior events arrive with video meant to support coaching, claims response, and accountability.

The company page dates the business to 2006. It reports 250,000 active systems operating worldwide. It also states $2.5M spent on research and development yearly. The same page describes a SOC 2 Type II-compliant data center for data security.

quote.text: Safety camera systems for every vehicle that carries people, students, or responsibility.
